desc: Confirm reduction: answer(R,X) = max dp[i] for i<=R and A[i]<=X, where dp[i] is LIS length ending exactly at i.
Parse N, Q, array A, and all queries; group query indices by R while preserving original output order.
Coordinate-compress A values into sorted unique ranks for the Fenwick tree.
Implement Fenwick tree with point-max update and prefix-max query.
Sweep R=1..N: compute dp[R] = 1 + prefix-max over ranks strictly less than rank(A[R]); update rank(A[R]) with dp[R]; then answer all queries with that R via prefix-max over compressed values <= X.
Map X to the largest compressed rank with A-value <= X (bisect), handle duplicates and X below all A correctly.
Run on Sample 1 and Sample 2, verify outputs 2/1/2 and 4/1/1/2/1/5/3/4.
Edge cases: all equal values, strictly decreasing A, X equal to prefix minimum, N=Q=1.
